content.text: {"core": "Source admits what has not yet entered — the threshold through which the unformed arrives into a domain. In Discipline, it opens onto the withdrawn practice: the tended, deliberate work receives its next incoming term. Unacknowledged, the intake runs unregistered, so what arrives is folded into the standing method as if already native, and the practice tightens around material it never examined as new.", "sheetLine": "Something entered the work unnoticed; the method now guards it as if it had always been there."}
